title: POCI-Diff: 3D-Layout Guided Diffusion for Controllable Synthetic Surveillance Data Generation
abstract: arXiv:2601.14056v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Training robust visual surveillance models requires large-scale datasets with precise spatial annotations, yet collecting real surveillance data is costly, privacy-sensitive, and often legally constrained. Synthetic data generation offers a compelling alternative, but existing methods lack fine-grained 3D control over object placement and appearance, limiting geometric consistency across camera viewpoints. We introduce POCI-Diff (Positioning Objects Consistently and Interactively), a framework that generates annotated synthetic scenes from explicit 3D bounding-box layouts with per-object semantic control. By integrating Blended Latent Diffusion with depth-conditioned ControlNet, POCI-Diff synthesises complex multi-object scenes in a single forward pass, binding individual text descriptions to specific 3D locations. translated_title: POCI-Diff：基于3D布局引导扩散模型的可控合成监控数据生成
translated_abstract: 训练鲁棒的视觉监控模型需要带有精确空间标注的大规模数据集，然而收集真实监控数据成本高昂、涉及隐私敏感问题，且常常受到法律限制。合成数据生成提供了一种极具吸引力的替代方案，但现有方法缺乏对物体放置与外观的细粒度3D控制，限制了跨相机视角的几何一致性。我们提出了POCI-Diff（一致且交互式地定位物体，Positioning Objects Consistently and Interactively），一个能够从显式3D边界框布局生成带标注合成场景、并支持逐物体语义控制的框架。通过将混合潜空间扩散与深度条件ControlNet相结合，POCI-Diff可在单次前向传播中合成复杂的多物体场景，并将各个文本描述绑定到特定的3D位置。我们进一步提出了一种免变形的编辑流程，支持物体的插入、移除与变换……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出POCI-Diff框架，通过3D边界框布局引导的扩散模型结合深度条件ControlNet，实现带逐物体语义控制的可控合成监控数据生成，保证了跨相机视角的几何一致性。
en_tdlr: POCI-Diff enables controllable generation of annotated synthetic surveillance data from explicit 3D bounding-box layouts by combining blended latent diffusion with depth-conditioned ControlNet, providing per-object semantic control and geometric consistency across camera viewpoints.
